hello i'm rajesh a cloud support
engineer here at the aws office in
dublin today i am going to show you how
to create a custom event pattern as
event bridge rule to capture certain
events for aws services so let's get
started
many aws services generate events that
eventbridge receives
when an aws service in your account
generates an event such as aws api calls
aws cloud trail automatically records
that event and send it to your account's
default event bus you can create rules
that use event patterns to filter
incoming events and then trigger a
target such as an
event bridge event bus
event bridge api destination or any aws
service
you can do that process in two steps
first determine the json format of the
incoming event
let's say you want to see the sample
event of amazon elastic compute cloud
instance state change event go to amazon
event bridge console
select sandbox from the left menu
options
scroll to sample event optional section
select aws events
under the sample events drop down list
select the ec2 instance state change
notification
below the drop down list you'll see the
sample event
then create an event pattern in the same
json format as the incoming event to
create a valid matching event pattern
follow the order of precedence
any fields that you don't specify in
your event pattern are automatically
matched for example if detail isn't
specified in the event pattern then the
event pattern matches every event with
any detail
to match fields that are one level down
in the json structure use curly braces a
json viewer might be helpful if you are
using at a larger event
structure the string to match from the
json event must be in a square bracket
you can include multiple values
in square brackets so that the event is
triggered when either of the values are
present in an incoming event
for example to trigger an event based on
every event sent by amazon ec2 or amazon
dynamodb
use this filter
you must remove any square brackets in
the json event sent by the service to be
sure that the event pattern is marked as
valid
for example to be notified when a type a
record is created for a specific amazon
route 53 hosted zone use this filter for
events sent by amazon route 53 to event
bridges
received from an amazon simple
notification service topic or amazon
cloud watch locks
use this filter pattern to be notified
when a type a record
is created for your hosted zone please
note that we have included only that
information that we want to filter in
the type a record creation events by in
your hosted zone
so now you know how to create a custom
event pattern as an event bridge rule to
capture certain events for aws services
thanks for watching and happy cloud
computing from all of us here at aws
[Applause]
